name: HarambOT trigger (12 bots, !gorilla)
description: Vanilla-style play, but bot 0 sends the admin chat command '!gorilla' at 30s to spawn Harambe, who then charges and launches skaters (server-side physics) for the rest of the game. Requires the job to grant bot 0's SteamId (botsteam004200, from seed 42) admin via the admin_steam_ids config field. Note: !gorilla is a toggle and Harambe auto-exits at game-end, so one trigger covers the first game of the phase. Run length is set per-job by phase_seconds.
